question.text: In the distribution stage, which combination of instruments is recommended for the early years of retirement?

answer.text: Bank FDs, SCSS (Senior Citizens Savings Scheme), and Post Office MIS

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series XVII (pp.86, 182-184, 200), bank FDs, SCSS, and Post Office MIS are recommended in the early years of retirement because they provide regular and predictable income. The Trap: A 100% equity allocation is not appropriate for early-retirement income needs, and concentrating only in gold/real estate or cryptocurrency does not deliver the regular income retirees require. Note: SCSS is exclusively for senior citizens and pays interest quarterly; MIS pays monthly. For the current SCSS interest rate, consult the latest official notification — rates are reset periodically.
